purpose: Declared contract every committed run must satisfy. Separate from the run files on purpose: a run recorded against a different dataset or different session settings must be rejected rather than quietly averaged in.

not_pinned.host: OS and architecture are compared across runs for consistency but not pinned to a value, so a Linux reproducer can commit its own session.
not_pinned.recorded_at: Timestamps must agree across a session but are not pinned.
